public_rationale: The negotiated changes removed criminal perjury penalties and the proposed specialist oversight division. The author's announcement also records a reduced attestation standard and narrower pre-harm enforcement. Together these support the ordinary reading of substantial weakening. The qualification matters: some oversight functions survived, and pre-harm enforcement was not wholly eliminated. Thus the broad claim is supported without endorsing every detail of the summary Marcus reproduced.
limitations: Significance is an evaluative judgment about the documented legal changes.
Direct comparison of the legislative versions could not be completed through read_page.
This assesses the August amendments, not the bill's later fate or its likely effectiveness.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: California's SB-1047 was significantly weakened in last-minute negotiations.

statement.excerpt: California’s SB-1047, not yet signed into law, but on its way to being one of the first really substantive AI bills in the US, primarily addressed to liability around catastrophic risks, was significantly weakened in last-minute negotiations.
statement.document_title: Why California’s AI Safety Bill should (still) be signed into law - and why that won’t be nearly enough

our_interpretation: The reference to Thursday identifies the August 15, 2024 amendment agreement, before publication of the post on August 20.
The ordinary reading of significantly weakened is a substantial reduction in safety obligations, enforcement powers, or oversight compared with the preceding version.
The claim does not require every provision to have weakened or the remaining bill to have become ineffective.
Last-minute negotiations describes the amendment process. It is not a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish material reductions in safety obligations, enforcement powers, or oversight in the August 15 amendment agreement.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The amendments preserved or strengthened those protections, with no material reductions beyond drafting or administrative changes.
